inspirations.name: Forging a blade
emote: This one will have a name.
inspirations.moment: forged {blade}, now in the town armory
inspirations.text: {name} works the forge at {work} through the night, singing to the steel. At dawn {given} lays a blade on the town hall's table like no other in {town}, and names it {blade}. It goes to the town armory.

inspirations.name: Throwing a feast
inspirations.text: {name} rolls the good barrels out of {work} and lays tables down the street: a feast for all of {neighbourhood}, for no reason but joy. The street will be talking of it for days.

inspirations.name: Carving a flourish
emote: A little higher on the left...
Nobody asked. I'm doing it anyway.
inspirations.text: Nobody asked {name} to, but {given} spends the day carving a fine column of stone and setting it up by {work}. The street is the prettier for it.

inspirations.name: Writing a song
emote: ♪ A new one, hear me out! ♪
♪ Of heroes who never turned back! ♪
inspirations.text: {name} has written a new song, of {hero} and {town}, and by evening every tavern is singing it. The mayor's standing rises, and {hero} stands a little taller.

inspirations.name: A flash of insight
emote: Of course! It was there all along!
inspirations.moment: had a flash of insight into {study}
inspirations.text: {name} bursts out of {work} with ink to the elbows: a flash of insight into {study}. The scholars are days nearer to it.

inspirations.name: A bumper harvest
emote: The earth loves us this year.
inspirations.text: {name} works from first light to last and brings in a crop at {work} the like of which nobody remembers: {qty} loads of food to the market.

inspirations.name: A great felling
inspirations.moment: felled a forest's worth of timber
inspirations.text: {name} takes to the woods like a giant and comes back with {qty} loads of timber for the yards.

inspirations.name: Full of good cheer
emote: What a day to be alive!
Mayor's doing all right, I say.
inspirations.moment: spent a day spreading good cheer
inspirations.text: {name} is full of good cheer today, and greets everyone in the street by name. Some of it rubs off.

breaks.name: On a bender
emote: Another! And one for the dog!
Why would I go to work?
breaks.text: {name} has had a bellyful of everything and goes on a bender at {tavern}{instead}. {given} drinks the cellar low and shows no sign of leaving.

breaks.name: In a rage
breaks.text: Something snaps in {name}. {given} smashes up {work}: {damage}. It takes the rest of the day to calm {given} down.

breaks.name: Sulking at home
breaks.moment: shut themselves away for two days
breaks.text: {name} shuts the door of {home} and won't come out for a day or two{short}.

breaks.name: Walking out
breaks.text: {name} has had enough. {given} drops {tools} in the street and walks out of {town} without a word{with}.
